TEN PLAYS: MECHANISM_VERIFIED 2, NOVEL_N1 1, OUTCOME_CREDITED 7, ASSERTED 0, NOT_A_PLAY 0, UNCLEAR 0. That 70% OUTCOME_CREDITED share sits alongside S111's 19-of-32 (59%), so the batch is not an outlier - the disease is population-wide.

WHAT I ACTUALLY MEASURED, because three of these plays could be re-run rather than only read. (1) renders/ng_refine_s95/fingerprints.json carries 6,358 legs over 108 days with peak_usd / retention / continuation, so ride.magnitude_staircase is testable at 30x its derivation n and 98 of the 108 days are outside its warm-season derivation window. The MONOTONE SHAPE SURVIVES exactly; every RUNG LEVEL is 4-21 points optimistic and the gap widens with size ($350 is 0.713 not 0.92; $500 is 0.823 not 1.00). (2) The nine staged state files let the selector.divergence_resolution gates be evaluated day by day: its up-angle unlock has NEVER been satisfiable on any of the 82 evaluable day-rows. (3) g*_mbo_evidence.json + g*_actual.json give a same-session flow-versus-move join for 59 sessions, which tests flow.resting_program_inverts_aggressor_tilt and magnitude.rally_quality_giveback_rung directly. Neither survives its discriminating claim.

THE PATTERN THAT REPEATS ACROSS THIS BATCH, and it is not the one I expected. It is not that the plays are fabricated - every number I traced verified, including all five G5 exemplars, all three young-chain exemplars, both seam quanta, the 0630/0624 controlled pair and the 0608/0715 flow prints. It is that THE DENOMINATOR IS NEVER COUNTED. Two program days out of twenty-one are named; three under-forecast days out of a block are named; three young-chain days are named; two seams out of eleven are named. In every case the named instances are the ones the outcome selected, and in three cases counting the rest reverses or dissolves the claim.

TWO FALSIFIERS CARRY AN UNMEASURABLE ESCAPE CLAUSE, AND BOTH WERE INVOKED ON THEIR FIRST ADVERSE INSTANCE. flow.resting_program_inverts_aggressor_tilt requires 'the program is demonstrably the dominant participant' - no served field measures program dominance - and 0714 was set aside on exactly that limb. magnitude.rally_quality_giveback_rung requires 'with no new driver' and B invoked a new driver on 0703->0706, its first out-of-block application. A falsifier whose second limb cannot be evaluated from the served state is not a falsifier; it is a licence to decline every refutation.

TWO OF MY FINDINGS ALREADY EXIST IN THE CORPUS, SCOPED TO ONE BLOCK, AND NEITHER REACHED THE BRAIN. grp21_mbo_specialist_C found the 16.4 HDD gate unreachable in June; I measured it unreachable in every block from G18 on (0 of 60) and the conjunction unreachable in all nine staged groups (0 of 82). grp20_mbo_specialist_D found a 13-print holiday session was the only fire in an accumulation window; I measured that sessions with under 20 big prints clear the 0.55 bar at 47% against 21% on well-populated sessions. The specialists are finding these; the merge is not banking them.

SCHEMA NOTE, cheap and it decides whether tooling can read the brain: structure.accumulation_arm_turn's `confidence` field holds PROSE, not a number (8 plays brain-wide do), and midweek.young_chain_extension_full_band and flow.resting_program_inverts_aggressor_tilt carry no `confidence` at all. Any consumer sorting or thresholding on confidence silently mishandles them.

RECORD DEFECT WORTH ONE LINE: midweek.young_chain_extension_full_band's evidence dates have their leading digit dropped - 'g9 0223' is 20251223 and 'g8 0119' is 20251119. As written they point into G13's and G11's windows. Both verify exactly once corrected, so this is a transcription defect, not a fabrication - but it makes the play's only evidence untraceable to anyone re-checking it.

audits.the_argument: A conditional continuation rate that rises with the favourable peak already reached: $50->0.43, $150->0.57, $250->0.75, $350->0.92, $500->1.00, derived on 372 legs over 12 warm-season days (S92), n=38 at the $350 rung and n=11 at $500. 'continuation' is defined in month_characterize.move_path as retention >= 0.5 where retention = end-of-1800s-window favourable excursion divided by peak. That is a real rate on a real conditioning variable and it is the one play in this batch that can be re-run, because renders/ng_refine_s95/fingerprints.json stores peak_usd, retention, continuation, time_to_peak_s and peaked_fast for 6,358 legs across 108 days - 98 of which post-date the derivation window. I re-ran it. THE SHAPE SURVIVES PERFECTLY AND THE LEVELS DO NOT: 0.386 / 0.519 / 0.626 / 0.713 / 0.823 against the claimed 0.43 / 0.57 / 0.75 / 0.92 / 1.00, monotone at every rung, with the shortfall widening as size rises (-0.04 at $50, -0.21 at $350, -0.18 at $500). The headline the runbook carries - 'the $350 crossing = a 92% keep-riding event; $500 = 100%' - is a small-n artifact; at n=1,307 and n=638 the true rates are 71% and 82%. Per cell, never pooled, the $350 rung holds at 0.701 hard_heat / 0.758 mod_heat / 0.652 unknown / 0.723 up-legs / 0.702 down-legs, so it is a stable relationship, not a regime accident. THE CAUSAL READING IS THE PART THAT DOES NOT HOLD: within a fixed 1800s window, median time-to-peak climbs monotonically with the peak bucket (12s / 454s / 924s / 1,146s / 1,343s / 1,521s), and since retention is end-over-peak, a leg that peaks at 1,521 of 1,800 seconds has only 279 seconds left in which to give back. Holding size fixed, timing dominates: in the 150-350 bucket peaked_fast legs continue 2 of 32 (0.063) against 729 of 1,863 (0.391) for slow peaks, a six-fold spread; in the 50-150 bucket, 6 of 226 (0.027) against 231 of 1,491 (0.155). So the staircase is largely SIZE ACTING AS A PROXY FOR TIME-TO-PEAK, which is what shape.grind_vs_spike already says causally ('grind holds, front-loaded spike round-trips'). The play also declares its own tension and I want that on the record as honesty rather than as a defect: status STABLE, confidence 0.90, forward_evidence 'NONE beyond derivation... Its high confidence reflects derivation strength, not forward evidence.'
audits.could_evidence_have_come_out_otherwise: Yes, emphatically, and I made it try. A mean-reverting tape would have produced a flat or descending staircase; it did not, at 6,358 legs, on 98 days outside the derivation window, and per cell. The rung LEVELS did come out otherwise - every one of them, in the same direction - which is exactly what a falsifiable measurement is supposed to be able to do. What could NOT have come out otherwise is the causal attribution to size: nothing in the derivation separates size from time-to-peak, and when I separate them the timing variable carries most of the effect.

audits.the_argument: The entire support is a list of five days on which the blind's guess was smaller than the realized move, with the conclusion 'on catalyst days the actual dominant move DWARFED the guess'. I traced all five to forecasts/grp5.json and every number is exact: 1008 guess +320 / actual -1,980; 1010 +150 / -1,490; 1016 -300 / -1,190; 1020 +580 / +2,770; 1021 +440 / +1,100. So the evidence is real and honestly recorded. But it is a RESIDUAL LOG, not a test - the evidence field is the forecast error, and the claim is that the forecast error exists. AND THE LOG DOES NOT MEASURE WHAT THE PLAY CLAIMS: two of the five exemplars are WRONG-SIGN days, not undersized days. On 1008 the guess was +320 and the actual was -1,980; on 1010 the guess was +150 and the actual was -1,490. A day whose sign was wrong carries no information about whether the magnitude scale is too small, and folding two sign misses into a five-item scale claim inflates it by 40%. Only 1016 (4x under), 1020 (4.8x under) and 1021 (2.5x under) are right-signed under-calls and can bear the argument. To the play's credit it refuses to act on itself - status HYPOTHESIS, confidence 0.30, call 'CANDIDATE correction ONLY... Do NOT globally rescale', an explicit ANTI-LOCK-IN clause holding a rival reading (higher-vol autumn regime) open, and forward_evidence 'SUPERSEDED... Winter bands replaced it from G7 onward.' I considered NOT_A_PLAY on those grounds and rejected it: it has a trigger, a read and a call, it makes a substantive magnitude claim, and classifying it out would lose the finding about its evidence.
audits.could_evidence_have_come_out_otherwise: No. Every item is a realized forecast error on a day chosen because the error was large. There is no denominator - the days on which the warm-season guess was the right size, or too big, were never counted - and no control regime. The one part that COULD have come out otherwise is the sign audit I ran on the play's own list, and it came out against the play: 2 of 5 exemplars are sign misses masquerading as scale misses.

instances.what_the_day_did: all five verify exactly against the committed record (guess_usd / actual_usd: +320/-1980, +150/-1490, -300/-1190, +580/+2770, +440/+1100). The numbers are real. But 1008 and 1010 are WRONG-SIGN days, so they cannot support a magnitude-scale claim; only 1016, 1020 and 1021 are right-signed under-calls

audits.the_argument: A set of per-event magnitude bands for the winter post-flip regime, and each band is literally the realized nets of the days that produced it with a line drawn around them: 'flip-confirm + chained crash -2400..-2900 (1208 -2730, 1209 -2840)', 'print-liquidity crash -1800..-4000 (1211 -3970, 1218 -1830, 1224 -2450)', and so on for six classes. The class LABELS were assigned to the days after the outcome split them. THE FORWARD CLAIM IS CIRCULAR AND THE CIRCLE IS VISIBLE INSIDE THE PLAY: forward_evidence reads 'FORWARD-CONFIRMED on G10 (both January crashes landed in band)', and the two January crashes are 0109 -2,760 and 0114 -2,710 - which the call field then writes in as the S99.2 bleed band's own defining exemplars ('crash -2400..-2900 SINGLE-day (0109 -2760, 0114 -2710)'). A genuine forward test was performed and then absorbed into the fit, so those two days can never test the bands again. AND A WHOLE GROUP'S FORWARD RECORD IS MISSING. The play fired SIX times in G12 - forecasts/grp12.json plays_fired on 0206, 0209, 0210, 0211, 0212, 0213 - and neither the forward field nor the g11_note mentions G12 at all. Scored against g12_score.json: -1,100 vs -1,160; -1,100 vs -830; +450 vs +240; -950 vs +610; -750 vs +110; -300 vs -1,400. Direction 4 of 6, and the block's largest down day was called at 4.7x too small. Worse, none of those six days is inside the play's own stated trigger ('sizing day-nets after a confirmed polarity flip'): the largest G12 move was -1,400, nowhere near the crash classes. The play was being used as a general magnitude lookup outside its regime, six times, unrecorded. Finally the G11 note contains an escape that makes the play unfalsifiable on its only claim: '0130 +5020 (guessed +300... ~17x)' is dismissed with 'the fires were band-selection calls made under a wrong polarity, which is the polarity input's issue, not the bands'.' If a 17x magnitude miss is never the magnitude play's fault, nothing can ever be.
audits.could_evidence_have_come_out_otherwise: The band derivation, no - the numbers in each band ARE the outcomes the band was drawn around, and the condition classes were assigned after the split. The G10 forward check, yes, genuinely - a band derived in December either contains two January days or it does not, and it did; but re-listing those same two days as the bleed band's exemplars spent that test. The G12 record, yes, and it was never assembled: 4 of 6 on direction with one 4.7x magnitude miss is a real result that nobody banked.

audits.the_argument: A post-onset confirm rather than a predictor: in a THIN regime only, price progressing hard through sell-dominant prints (progress per 1,000 lots at roughly 2x the day baseline, 38-47 ticks per thousand on 0121 and 1223 against controls at or below 17) is read as offers being WITHDRAWN rather than buyers attacking - the F2 fingerprint from the S101 squeeze retrospective. The mechanism is a real microstructure distinction (supply removal versus demand arrival produce the same price path but opposite lot-efficiency), the two instances are named, a quantitative separation is stated with named controls, and a NEGATIVE result is declared rather than hidden: 'Non-discriminating on liquid tapes (1128) - thin regimes only.' Confidence 0.5, status PROVISIONAL, forward_evidence 'NONE'. That combination - argued mechanism, named instances, declared scope limit, honest zero forward evidence - is NOVEL_N1 as the rubric defines it, and n=2 with a control is if anything stronger than the class requires. I am NOT upgrading it to MECHANISM_VERIFIED, because I could not verify a single number in it. The discriminating quantity, progress per 1,000 lots, is not computed in any committed file: renders/ng_refine_s95/fingerprints.json carries peak_usd, retention and the turn markers but no volume or lot field; g*_mbo_evidence.json carries phase sflow and pxchg but no lot-normalised progress; and price is masked in the blind state by design. The two exemplar DAYS are traceable - 20260121 net_actual +3,820 in g11_score.json, 20251223 actual +5,010 in g9_score.json - but the ratchet reading on them is not stored anywhere I can open. Every one of the fifteen corpus appearances is a stand-down, and in each case for the same declared reason: squeeze_watch's spread limb is genuinely price-masked so calendar_limb_satisfied_live is null, or calendar_dte_limb_satisfied_live is false at dte 16-21 against a <=7 window. The specialists stood it down as UNKNOWN rather than as negative, which is the correct handling and is worth recording as a positive about the run discipline.
audits.could_evidence_have_come_out_otherwise: As described, yes - the play states a numeric separation (38-47 versus <=17 ticks per thousand lots) with named controls on both sides, and 1128 is a declared non-separating liquid tape, which is a negative result that could have killed the scoping. But I cannot confirm that any of it was computed the way it is described, because the quantity does not exist in the committed corpus. So the honest answer is: the SHAPE of the evidence is falsifiable; its CONTENT is unverifiable from here.
audits.condition_can_change_state: UNKNOWABLE from the committed corpus, and that is the finding. The trigger has two limbs: a thin-regime gate and progress-per-1,000-lots >= ~2x the day baseline. The lot-normalised progress is not stored in fingerprints.json, in any g*_mbo_evidence.json, or in any grp*_state.json, so the bar cannot be evaluated on a single day of the walk. What I CAN say is that the play's gating sibling is degenerate in the modern blocks: squeeze_watch.calendar_dte_limb_satisfied_live is false across G22 at dte 18-21 and the spread limb is masked all block, which is why all fifteen corpus appearances are stand-downs.
audits.falsifier: The brain's falsifier field is EMPTY. The play's own scope note supplies half of one ('non-discriminating on liquid tapes'), which means a thin-regime session showing the ratchet fingerprint and then failing to sustain would discharge it. WHAT WOULD SETTLE THE WHOLE THING: a leg-grain replay that computes ticks-per-1,000-lots per session and writes it into the evidence store alongside phase sflow, then re-scores 20260121 and 20251223 against a matched set of thin non-squeeze sessions. Until that field is served, this play is unexercisable and unauditable, and it should not accumulate confidence in either direction.

audits.the_argument: THIS IS THE MOST CONSEQUENTIAL FINDING IN MY BATCH, because the play is a SELECTOR - the machinery that decides which angle wins a bimodal split - and its up-arm has never been reachable. The rule defaults a storage-versus-weather split to the S3-bearish DOWN angle, and lets the weather-cold-add UP angle win ONLY IF BOTH gates hold: (a) near-window D0..D+3 max forecast gw-HDD >= ~16.4, AND (b) session_b_share >= ~0.50. I evaluated both gates day by day on every staged group that serves them. GATE (a) FIRES 0 OF 10 IN G18, 0 OF 10 IN G19, 0 OF 10 IN G20, 0 OF 10 IN G21, 0 OF 10 IN G22 AND 0 OF 10 IN G23 - zero of sixty, with block maxima of 11.46, 6.06, 2.95, 0.80, 0.37 and 0.24 against a 16.4 bar. In the winter blocks it is degenerate the other way, 12 of 12 in G12 and 12 of 12 in G13. It splits days only in the shoulder, 8 of 12 in G14 and 7 of 12 in G15. In the BIRTH BLOCK G16 it fires on exactly ONE day out of eleven - 0405, at 16.93 - and that one day is the play's own named positive control. GATE (b) fires 3 of 88 served sessions (3.4%), which is the S108 normalization defect the brain already records. THE CONJUNCTION - the up-angle unlock, the entire discriminating content of the selector - IS SATISFIED ON 0 OF THE 82 DAY-ROWS across nine staged groups where both gates are evaluable. It has never once been possible for the weather angle to win. The evidence field is 'n: 3 splits IN this block, all resolved DOWN correctly by the gates' - and I verified all three against g16_score.json (0401 -600, 0406 -470, 0407 -220, exact). But G16 closed DOWN on 10 of 11 days (-790, -650, -110, -600, -130, +400, -470, -220, -450, -610, -190). A gate that can only ever emit DOWN, scored on a block that was down 91% of the time, gets 3 of 3 by construction. The brain's own negative_result_reported blames gate (b) and names the G20 symptom (sub-0.50 on 10 of 10 in a block that rallied +1,860) without identifying that gate (a) is worse and unconditional. AND THE CORPUS ALREADY KNEW: grp21_mbo_specialist_C wrote 'selector.divergence_resolution arm (a)... cannot fire in June by construction - the same failure shape as the b_share bar that was just fixed, on the other axis.' That was scoped to one block and never reached the brain.
audits.could_evidence_have_come_out_otherwise: NO, and this is the strongest form of the failure. The play's three supporting instances all resolve DOWN because DOWN is the only output the gates can produce; the 'positive control' 0405 clears gate (a) but fails gate (b), so it is not a control on the rule as written either. There is no configuration of the served data, on any of 82 evaluable day-rows across nine groups, in which the evidence could have come out UP. An arm that cannot fire cannot be wrong, and cannot be right.

audits.the_argument: The claim is that a fresh chain (age 0-1), chain-sided, with aligned D-1 flow delivers the FULL class band and must not get the counter-print damping - and the derived magnitude is stated as 'full class band (young chain-sided ran +1950..+5010 vs capped blinds +120..+800)'. That range IS the three realized moves, and the capped range IS the three blind guesses. The evidence is three days on which the blind under-forecast badly, with the class label attached afterwards. I traced all three and every number verifies - but TWO OF THE THREE DATES ARE MIS-WRITTEN IN THE BRAIN, with the leading digit dropped. 'g9 0223 Tue young_turn_chain_extension: blind +600, ACTUAL +5010' is 20251223 (g9_score.json: guess +600, actual +5,010, archetype 'young_turn_chain_extension', dow Tue - exact). 'g8 0119 Wed post_stabilization_hold_drift_up: blind +120, ACTUAL +1950' is 20251119 (g8_score.json: guess +120, actual +1,950, archetype 'post_stabilization_hold_drift_up', dow Wed - exact). As written, 0223 falls inside G13's window and 0119 inside G11's, so anyone re-tracing goes to the wrong block and finds nothing. The third, 'g14 0311', is correct (g14_score.json: guess +800, actual +2,030). THE MISSING PIECE IS THE DENOMINATOR. Three days delivered a full band. How many days met the same trigger - chain age 0-1, chain-sided, D-1 flow aligned - and did NOT deliver one was never counted, and cannot be counted from the committed corpus, because chain age and chain-sided classification are derived narrative labels, not served fields. So the play's rate is 3 of 3 out of an unknown population, and the class labels in the score files were themselves assigned in the same post-mortem that produced the play. I also note the play carries NO confidence field at all and its falsifier field is empty, while its does_not_explain clause is the only real constraint on it.
audits.could_evidence_have_come_out_otherwise: No. All three instances are days selected because the actual dwarfed the blind; the band is the set of those actuals; the class name was assigned after the fact by the same pass. There is no negative instance anywhere in the record - no young chain-sided aligned-flow day that failed to extend - and no counted population from which 3 of 3 could be a rate rather than a list.

audits.the_argument: A SIGN play: recurring big-print buy-absorption (big_print_b_share >= 0.55 on >= 2 of the last ~5 sessions, NON-consecutive) under a sub-0.50 sell tape against an extreme-and-worsening COT short is ACCUMULATION rather than down-continuation, so move the sign toward the turn. THE DISCRIMINATING PARAMETER WAS FITTED TO THE OUTCOME, AND THE PLAY SAYS SO IN ITS OWN CONFIDENCE FIELD: 'the window fix (~5 non-consecutive) is what makes the arm catch spaced accumulation; the strict 2-of-3 missed G17 entirely.' The window was widened from 2-of-3 to >=2-of-~5 after the fact, and the acceptance test for the widening was that the arm then fired on 0422 - the day the G17 block turned. grp17_mbo_specialist_C states the loop explicitly: 'A strict 2-of-3-consecutive window sees zero of this and rides the S3-down default straight through the turn - which is exactly the blind's 0415/0422 misses.' A free parameter tuned until the rule fires on a known outcome is the definition of the class. THE CREDIT IS ALSO A REFINE NUMBER, not a blind one: grp17_mbo_refined_r2.json records 0422 refined +130 against actual +140 with weight_assigned blind 0.30 / causal_mbo 0.70, so 70% of the number came from a read that had the price curve. AND THE ARM'S OWN NEXT TEST FAILED - the forward field records 'C's 0506 RTS-up was wrong (buy-absorb-failing DOWN)'; g18 0506 closed -530. I ran the literal arm over every core Tue/Wed day in g18-g23 on the served state. It fires three times: 20260603 (+750 UP, correct), 20260616 (+970 UP, correct), 20260617 (-970 DOWN, wrong). But on the basis the brain has NOW LICENSED - the sub-0.50 limb must read session_b_share_two_sided - 0616 dissolves (two-sided 0.520 fails the sub-0.50 limb) and G20 is unevaluable (two-sided is served only from G21). That leaves 20260617 as the ONLY evaluable modern fire on the corrected basis, and it delivered -970, the block's second-largest down day. The old basis is degenerate: session_b_share clears 0.50 on 3 of 88 sessions, so the sell-tape limb is TRUE 96.6% of the time and contributes nothing. Two further defects are already in the corpus and neither reached the brain: grp20_mbo_specialist_D found the thin-tape guard REMOVES the only fire in the 0528 window (0525 Memorial Day, 0.599 on 13 big prints), and I confirm the general risk - sessions with under 20 big prints clear 0.55 at 7 of 15 (47%) against 14 of 67 (21%) on well-populated sessions, so the window is systematically contaminated by holiday and reopen stubs. grp21_mbo_specialist_C found the arm has NO EXPIRY and ran it a fifth consecutive session on 0617 after the turn had already paid three sessions: 'the accumulation arm was non-falsifiable toward UP.'
audits.could_evidence_have_come_out_otherwise: No, at the point that matters. The window length is the play's only free parameter and it was selected by whether the arm fired on the day the block turned, so the G17 evidence could not have come out otherwise - any window that failed the test would have been rejected. What CAN come out otherwise is everything measured since, and it has: 0506 wrong, 0617 wrong on the corrected basis, 0616 dissolved by the re-pointed series, and the two-sided re-point never re-derived on the original evidence. The play's own record is admirably explicit about all of this; nothing here was hidden, it was just never added up.

audits.the_argument: A weekend or holiday reopen seam in a crowded-short regime carries a DIRECTIONAL gap prior: a WORSENING COT WoW means the seam is the covering rally's firing window, so attach an UP gap prior; a FLAT WoW means no prior and the gap reverts to noise. The mechanism is a loaded-spring argument and the birth evidence is better than it looks: g19's two weekends fired an IDENTICAL +580 up gap from OPPOSITE inherited exit states (0511 an aligned-sell press, 0518 a covering close-on-high), which is a real control - if the gap were carried by the inherited state the two would have differed. That is a measurement that could have come out otherwise. WHAT NOBODY EVER DID WAS ASSEMBLE THE SEAM TALLY, so I did. Armed means MM 1y percentile below ~3 and chg_wow negative, read off the served COT at each seam. ARMED SEAMS: 20260511 +580, 20260518 +580, 20260601 +690, 20260615 -750, 20260622 +1,210 - FOUR OF FIVE UP, mean +462. UNARMED SEAMS: 20260427 -50, 20260504 +440, 20260525 -240, 20260629 +50, 20260706 -580, 20260713 -360 - two of six up, mean -123. THE INSTANCE THE BRAIN NEVER RECORDED IS 20260622, AND IT IS THE MOST INTERESTING DAY IN MY BATCH. It is armed by the IDENTICAL COT reading that armed the 0615 falsifier - report 2026-06-09, MM net -122,617, pctile 2.83, chg_wow -7,763 - because the next report did not publish until 2026-06-22 15:30 ET, after the Sunday reopen, and the state correctly serves it at age_days 9.35. Same armed state, one week apart, gapped -750 and then +1,210. That is the burn-gate's 0624/0625 shape exactly (identical served inputs, opposite outcomes), except that here it cuts BOTH ways and the brain recorded only the negative half. Meanwhile grp22_B_20260622 stood the play down and wrote 'The four scorable walk seams run +580/+690/-350/-750 = a coin flip' - a tally that omits g19's second +580 and INCLUDES 20260608 (-350), which is not armed at all (chg_wow +19,572, improving). B then emitted a +20 gap against a realized +1,210. This is S110's structural lesson recurring verbatim: a tally assembled from independent slices is systematically incomplete and must be recomputed at the coordinator.
audits.could_evidence_have_come_out_otherwise: Yes, at birth and forward. At birth the two g19 seams had opposite inherited exit states and could have gapped opposite ways; they did not. Forward, the play wrote a falsifier verbatim before the 0614 seam and the falsifier FIRED at -750 - which is the strongest single thing in its record, because a play that pre-registers a falsifier and then reports it firing against itself is doing the job. My own armed-versus-unarmed split could equally have come out flat and did not (4/5 versus 2/6). The honest limit is that 'worsening WoW' and 'crowded short' co-move by construction - armed seams sit at pctile 2.83/0.94/0.94/2.83/2.83 and unarmed at 8.49/10.38/16.04/29.25/29.25/50.0 - so at n=11 seams I cannot separate which limb is doing the work.

audits.the_argument: The microstructure mechanism is sound and I want that said first: a large resting order is filled BY the crowd, so a program working the offer prints aggressor-BUY while price falls. That is correct market mechanics and it generalises a case A had already named for covering shorts. The instances are real and traced: G21 0608 printed +3,261 of net aggressor buy while falling -890 with absorb_session TRUE, and G23 0715 printed +6,326 of buy - the block's largest tilt - and closed -60 on BCOM roll day 5, with C matching the ph2 fingerprint to within ten units of 0608 (+2,858/-120 versus +2,868/+40). WHAT IS NOT TESTED IS THE DISCRIMINATION, which is where the play's whole content lives: the claim is not that aggressor tilts invert, it is that they invert ON PROGRAM DAYS, so a same-signed tilt there is SUSPECT. I ran that directly. Joining g*_mbo_evidence.json total_sflow to g*_actual.json day moves gives 59 sessions in g18-g23 with both a nonzero tilt and a nonzero move. On the 21 program-or-expiry days the tilt AGREES with the day sign 12 times (57.1%). On the 38 other days it agrees 13 times (34.2%). So the aggressor tilt inverts 65.8% of the time on ORDINARY days and only 42.9% of the time on program days - the inversion is a general property of this tape and program days are, if anything, the LEAST inverted. Per group, never pooled as the conclusion, the program-day agreement rate is greater than or equal to the non-program rate in five of six blocks (g18 1/3 vs 0/7, g19 3/4 vs 2/6, g20 1/2 vs 3/8, g21 2/5 vs 2/5, g22 1/1 vs 4/8, g23 4/6 vs 2/4). The play named the two program days out of twenty-one that inverted. And its own third instance points the same way: 0714 fired limb one of the play's falsifier (tilt +3,747 buy, day +200 up, on a GSCI-and-BCOM roll day) and was set aside on limb two, 'the program is demonstrably the dominant participant' - a condition no served field measures. C was right not to bank a falsification it could not show; the defect is that the falsifier was written with a limb that can never be evaluated.
audits.could_evidence_have_come_out_otherwise: For the mechanism, yes, and it holds - a 65.8% baseline inversion rate is a real, falsifiable property of this tape and it is the play's genuine contribution. For the DISCRIMINATION, no: two program days were selected from twenty-one by their outcome, the control condition was never run, and the falsifier's second limb is unmeasurable. When I run the control it comes out against the play at 57.1% versus 34.2% - which at n=21 versus n=38 is about 1.7 sigma, so not decisive, but it certainly is not support.

audits.the_argument: D-1 rally QUALITY is claimed to sort next-day magnitude: an ALIGNED rally holds, a CONVICTION-NEGATIVE pop (rise on net-sell or absorption) gives back 50-70% next session, and covering-financed up-legs get credit only to the reversal-reclaim. The founding pair is genuinely well designed and it verifies exactly: 20260630 rose +790 with ph2 sflow -4,266 against pxchg +880, ph_absorb TRUE and absorb_session TRUE, and 20260701 gave back -500 = 63%; 20260624 rose the SAME +790 on aligned phases (+296/+84/-69), absorb_session FALSE, and 20260625 held at -60. Same magnitude, opposite conviction, opposite sequel - that is a controlled comparison and it could have come out otherwise. BUT THE BAND IS ONE DAY'S OUTCOME. '50-70%' is the single realized give-back on 0701 (63%) with a range drawn around it, and I tested it. Over every D-1-up-leg to next-session pair within a group in g17-g23 (g*_mbo_evidence.json joined to actuals), conviction-negative days number 21: the next day closes DOWN 12 times (57%), the median give-back is 21%, and ONLY 2 OF 21 land in the prescribed 50-70% band. Aligned days number 12: next day DOWN 6 times (50%), 1 of 12 in band. I ran two further operationalizations in case mine was too loose - strict absorb_session gives 8/14 (57%) versus 10/19 (53%) with 1 and 2 in band; absorb-or-final-phase-absorb gives 12/20 (60%) versus 6/13 (46%) with 1 and 2 in band. So the DIRECTIONAL half has a weak but consistent lean in the claimed direction across all three definitions (57-60% against 46-53%), and the MAGNITUDE half - which is the play's actual call, it is a magnitude play - is not supported anywhere: the prescribed band captures one or two cases in fourteen to twenty-one. ITS FIRST OUT-OF-BLOCK APPLICATION CONTRADICTS IT. In grp23_B_20260706 the play fires, correctly classifies 0703 as a conviction-negative pop (net +410 on sflow -1,005, absorb_session TRUE), prescribes '-200..-290' of give-back and caps the session at +100. The realized session net was +680 UP - the day move was only +100 because the gap was -580, a component this play does not govern. B then invoked the play's own 'no new driver' escape on the same day, so the adverse instance was neutralised at the moment it occurred.
audits.could_evidence_have_come_out_otherwise: The 0624-versus-0630 pair, yes - two same-sized up-legs with different conviction could have produced the same sequel and did not, which is real. The BAND, no - 50-70% is one realized give-back with a bracket around it, and there is no population behind it. The forward claim 'n>=3 instances spanning g19/g22' is not a rate either; I could locate the g22 pair and the 0703 covering-grammar reference, and when I count the full population the band does not survive.

The CONVICTION classifier is healthy: across the 33 D-1-up-leg pairs in g17-g23 it splits 21 conviction-negative against 12 aligned (or 14/19 on the strict absorb_session reading), so both states occur freely and it is not a degenerate bar.
